note: Pre-Phase-G baseline. Per-field floors in reports/ were measured against the parity-locked current-main extractor (golden fixture). HELD-OUT matches are NEVER used to fit calibration (Phase F2) or pick active-learning candidates (Phase F4). Phase G performs a single decoder bump covering C+D+E+F; re-stamp decoder_version then.

250.source: research/OCR-SS/Manual OCR benchmark for verification V2.md

2577.coverage: Operator-reviewed. 10 skater subjects (5 for/BGM + 5 against), each with build class, handedness, 3 X-Factors + tiers, and 23 attributes. Goalies CPU. Benchmark golden extracted from the REAL (second) game's loadout window only (t76-116 @3fps) -- the clip's cancelled first game is excluded (see fixtures/fixture_match2577_loadout/PROVENANCE.md). Gated in test_field_benchmark.py at measured floors: gamertag 0.90 / player_number 1.00 / position 1.00 / build_class 0.90 / x_factor_name 0.86 / x_factor_tier 0.90 / attribute_value 0.74 / persona 0.50. 10/10 subjects align; one subject-split phantom shows as captain fn.

967.coverage: Operator-reviewed. Both sides fully labeled: 10 skaters (5 BGM/for + 5 away/against), each with build class, handedness, 3 X-Factors (loadout-sourced tiers), and all 23 attributes. Goalies are CPU on both sides (no card). X-Factors are read loadout-first; the lobby-table tiers are an unreliable colour-guess backup and are ignored when a loadout card exists.

968.coverage: Operator-reviewed. Both sides fully labeled: 10 skaters, each with build class, handedness, 3 X-Factors, and all 23 attributes (deltas on AP-boosted cards). Goalies are CPU. Away-LD build is Enforcer (Grizzer - ENF).

new_validation.note: DONE 2026-07-01. 2577 benchmarked, golden committed, gated, and promoted into splits.validation (see matches.2577). Golden generated from the real game's loadout window (t76-116 @3fps) via fixtures/fixture_match2577_loadout/ (PROVENANCE + 905-record golden); reports/2577-baseline.json holds the measured baseline; floors locked in test_field_benchmark.py. Note on the deferred match-250 ratchet: it is a NO-OP -- the Phase B retrain only touched the closed-vocab image heads, which are not wired into the live extraction path, so regenerating the 250 golden yields identical text-path numbers and the 250 floors already sit exactly at measured (build/x_factor 0.80). 250 floors are unchanged by design.
